title: Plus Size Lace High Low Wedding Guest Dress
descriptionHtml:
Elevate your wedding guest look with this stunning Plus Size Lace Puff Sleeve Dress! Featuring delicate lace detailing and romantic puff sleeves, this dress offers a flattering silhouette that celebrates your curves. Perfect for dancing the night away or enjoying a heartfelt celebration, you'll feel effortlessly chic and confident!


Tips: Prioritize selecting based on the bust measurement; the entire garment is stretchy, and the waist and hip areas can stretch by at least 2 inches.

 

 

Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Midi.


Sleeve Style: Short sleeves.


Closure: Back zipper.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises lace.


Stretch: Fabric is high stretch.
